Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Chrono Reversal

Time Wizard (Chronos) forces every enemy (including flyings) in his range to walk back towards their spawn during its duration (including not only the currently affected targets, but also those who enter his range while the ability is active) . It does not affect bosses.

  • Global Cooldown: 90s
  • Duration: 5s

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

One of the best units for purposes such as obtaining Stat Cubes/Perfect Stat Cubes, sacrificing for Griffin's ascension or for limit breaking units due to him being easy to evolve.
